title: Pre-pullback equality of coordinate Kunneth routes
statement: For finite A and proper f, the ordered-projection/direct-comparison route equals the projection/exchange route before applying pullback and the counit.

proof.text: Expand both routes using the ordered projection, exchange, comparison, and direct comparison mate equations and apply naturality of the tensor comparison.

lean.statement: theorem coordinateKunnethFactorization_route_eq [Finite A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) : (orderedProjectionIso A f ((push A f).obj M) ((pull A f).obj L)).hom ≫ (push A f).map (comparison A f L M).inv ≫ (directComparison A f).hom.app _ = ((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app M).app ((push A f).obj ((pull A f).obj L)) ≫ (push A f).map (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj M).map (exchange1 A f ((pull A f).obj L)).hom ≫ (orderedProjectionIso A (pullback.fst f f) M ((pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj ((pull A f).obj L))).hom)
